import statistics
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

        + [float(v) for v in obj.cval.ravel()]
        + estimates
        + standard_errors
    )

    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()

import json
import math
import statistics
import sys
import time
import warnings
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/urca")
from urca.cajolst import cajolst

_BIN = Path(__file__).with_name("denmark_sjd.bin")


def _denmark_sjd():
    raw = np.fromfile(_BIN, dtype=np.float64)

def clean(value):
    if isinstance(value, np.ndarray):
        return clean(value.tolist())
    if isinstance(value, float) and math.isnan(value):

def normalize(text: str) -> str:
    import re

    out = []
    prev_blank = False
    for line in text.splitlines():
        line = line.rstrip()
        line = re.sub(r" +", " ", line) if line else line
        blank = line == ""
        if blank and prev_blank:
